title: From Earth to Orbit, France’s Ecosystem Delivers Agentic Computing at Scale With NVIDIA
script:
France is now deploying agentic AI across its national industries.
NVIDIA infrastructure is powering these deployments in finance and the public sector.
The effort began at the AI Action Summit in February 2025.
Compute commitments were solidified at the Choose France Summits in 2025 and 2026.
These agents are currently active in sectors like space and scientific research.
Companies are moving from mere ambition to large scale application.
France is now building the deliberate groundwork for these AI systems.
Would you trust an AI agent to manage your country's infrastructure?
